menu.name: Pounded Yam & Egusi
menu.description: Hand-pounded the way it's always been done. Smooth, stretchy, and paired perfectly with our rich melon-seed soup. Comfort food, no compromises.

menu.name: Amala & Ewedu
menu.description: Hand-crafted the way it's always been done. Silky amala meets our signature ewedu — smooth, earthy, and deeply satisfying. Comfort food, no compromises.

menu.name: Eba & Egusi
menu.description: Made the way it's always been done. Soft, pliable eba paired with hearty melon-seed soup loaded with assorted meat. Comfort food, no compromises.

menu.name: Semo & Ogbono
menu.description: Prepared the way it's always been done. Smooth semo with our thick, savory ogbono soup. Comfort food, no compromises.

menu.name: Efo Riro
menu.description: Bold, peppery, and loaded with assorted meat and fish. A rich vegetable stew simmered layer by layer — the dish jollof-lovers secretly crave just as much.

menu.name: Jollof Rice
menu.description: Smoky, spiced, and simmered to perfection over an open flame — the dish that started it all.

menu.name: Fried Rice
menu.description: Buttery, colorful, and packed with fresh vegetables — the crowd-pleaser on every table.

menu.name: Ofada Rice & Ayamase
menu.description: Earthy, robust rice paired with our fiery green pepper sauce — a bold classic for the adventurous eater.

menu.name: Suya Platter
menu.description: Charcoal-grilled, spice-crusted, and fiery. Smoky beef coated in our signature suya spice — not for the faint of heart.

menu.name: Croaker Fish
menu.description: Fresh-grilled, tender, and seasoned deep to the bone — simple, clean, and packed with flavor.

menu.name: Meat & Egg in Stew
menu.description: Tender meat and boiled egg swimming in a rich, spicy tomato stew — tasty, delicious, and deeply satisfying.

menu.name: Yamarita + Fish Sauce
menu.description: Crispy fried plantain-yam fritters served with a savory fish sauce — golden, crunchy, and impossible to stop eating.

menu.name: Moin Moin
menu.description: Steamed bean pudding, soft and savory — the perfect companion to any main.

menu.name: Plantain (Dodo)
menu.description: Sweet, caramelized, pan-fried to golden perfection — the side that steals the show.

menu.name: Zobo
menu.description: Fresh hibiscus, ginger, and a touch of spice — our zobo is cold, bold, and refreshing.

menu.name: Chapman
menu.description: Citrus, grenadine, and a splash of soda — bright, fruity, and endlessly drinkable.
